debug.input_assessment: The smart brief and source messaging are consistent: the product is positioned for enterprise office teams, managed fleets, shared workgroups, and business-critical documents. The selected camera is a tight printer_FrontCloseUp profile with no local props or background details, so source-specific papers, forms, meeting packets, and office furnishings cannot be shown.
debug.count_explanation: Generated exactly 20 distinct prompt texts, sorted by descending source relevance and then reference proximity. Office prompts lead because they are the only source-grounded environment; Home, Office, Education, Gaming, Café, and Creative Studio are all represented across the full bank.
ignored_fields: Runtime metadata such as run IDs, model labels, status timestamps, and export timestamps were treated as non-scene metadata.
Search ranking details were not used as product scene evidence except where they reinforced limitations; ranks and URLs were not treated as lifestyle settings.
Rejected or cautionary copy directions were not used as affirmative scene support.
debug.diversity_summary: Because printer_FrontCloseUp permits zero props and zero background details, diversity is limited to ordinary support surfaces, lighting, and broad setting language. The bank varies among corporate office desks and tables, home desks and end tables, café tables, creative office tables, gaming desks with RGB/neon light, and simple education tables.
limitations: The tight zero-prop camera prevents visible contracts, invoices, forms, meeting packets, notebooks, shelves, plants, and people.
